Create a site

A new internal site, linked to a planning cluster, an enterprise unit, a calendar and an address, ready for its warehouses.

Status
Not walked yet
Module
Master Data
Length
17 steps
Updated
25 Oct 2026
Applies to
Infor LN

A task on its own, done beside the processes.

Note
Nobody has walked these steps in LN yet. Follow them as written, and expect a screen or a label to differ. Walk it to say, at each step, whether it matched.

Walk it

Steps

Screen
Master Data➔Enterprise Model➔Enterprise Structure➔Sites (tcemm0150m000)

Why LN works this way. A site is a business location, and the record ties it to one planning cluster, one enterprise unit, one calendar and, through its address, one country. Under multisite a site cannot exist without its cluster, so the cluster and the enterprise unit are chosen from ones that already exist. Saving makes only the site: its warehouses, departments and settings by site are added afterwards, from its own tabs.

StepActionYou should see
1Open Sites (tcemm0150m000)The list of sites, each with its Planning Cluster
2Choose an internal site in the same country as the new one, and double-click its lineSite (tcemm0650m000) opens on that site
3Read its Planning ClusterWrite downplanning cluster
4Read its Calendar, both partsWrite downcalendar
5Read its Enterprise UnitWrite downenterprise unit
6Read its AddressWrite downaddress
7Close the site without changing anythingBack on Sites
8Press NewAn empty Site opens, Logistic Company already filled in
9Type the new site's code in Site
10Type a description in the box beside it
11Enter the address from step 6 in AddressThe address text shows beside the code
12On the General tab, enter the cluster from step 3 in Planning ClusterThe cluster's description shows beside it
13Enter the calendar code and availability type from step 4 in CalendarThe calendar's description shows below it
14Enter the enterprise unit from step 5 in Enterprise UnitThe unit's description shows beside it
15Leave Default Warehouse empty and Administrative Only cleared
16Press SaveThe site is saved, and Site can no longer be typed in
17Close the site and press Refresh on SitesThe new site is in the list with its Planning Cluster

If something goes wrong

SymptomWhat to do
Save refuses the recordCalendar and Address are required; both parts of Calendar need a value, see step 13
Planning Cluster cannot be filled inCheck Administrative Only is cleared; planning clusters are unavailable for an administrative site
A warehouse or department added later is refused for its countryThe site's address sets its country, and every entity linked to the site must be in that country; see step 11
The new site is not in the listPress Refresh on Sites, see step 17

Variations

Variations
CaseWhat changes
An external site

On the External Relations tab, select External Site, then Subcontractor Site or Customer Site, and name the business partner who owns it

An administrative site

Select Administrative Only; the site gets no planning cluster and holds only offices, such as a purchase or sales office

A cluster of its own

Create the cluster first in Planning Clusters (tcemm1135m000), then use it at step 12

Create a site

  1. This task starts at Master Data➔Enterprise Model➔Enterprise Structure➔Sites (tcemm0150m000)

    Open Sites

    You should see

    The list of sites, each with its Planning Cluster

  2. Choose an internal site in the same country as the new one, and double-click its line

    You should see

    Site (tcemm0650m000) opens on that site

  3. Read its Planning Cluster

    Write down

  4. Read its Calendar, both parts

    Write down

  5. Read its Enterprise Unit

    Write down

  6. Read its Address

    Write down

  7. Close the site without changing anything

    You should see

    Back on Sites

  8. Press New

    You should see

    An empty Site opens, Logistic Company already filled in

  9. Type the new site's code in Site

  10. Type a description in the box beside it

  11. Enter the address from step 6 in Address

    You should see

    The address text shows beside the code

  12. On the General tab, enter the cluster from step 3 in Planning Cluster

    You should see

    The cluster's description shows beside it

  13. Enter the calendar code and availability type from step 4 in Calendar

    You should see

    The calendar's description shows below it

  14. Enter the enterprise unit from step 5 in Enterprise Unit

    You should see

    The unit's description shows beside it

  15. Leave Default Warehouse empty and Administrative Only cleared

  16. Press Save

    You should see

    The site is saved, and Site can no longer be typed in

  17. Close the site and press Refresh on Sites

    You should see

    The new site is in the list with its Planning Cluster
